messages:
alex: FYI I opened a docs PR to clarify model-catalog entries for orca-lite-13b-q4 and add migration notes + benchmark snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872

maria: Nice — is this where we also add the SDK snippet change for streaming? I ran into users confused about stream param rename.

bryan: Which rename? we changed stream=true -> response_mode='stream' in the SDK last month. examples need updating.

sophia: Also spotted an incorrect token limit in the current card (said 32k but the quantized build supports ~30k effective). PR should mention "effective context" for quantized variants.

alex: Good calls. PR currently includes: - updated limits table - short bench results (throughput, p95 latency) - link to SDK snippet (needs replacing) - compatibility notes for quantized variants

alex: Here's the current bench snippet in the PR:```bash
# local microbench (A100 40GB, batch=1)
python bench.py --model orca-lite-13b-q4 --seq 2048
# results: 12.3 tok/s, p95 45ms
```

bryan: Can we add hardware column explicitly (A100 40GB, A10, and a CPU-quantized run)? otherwise people misinterpret numbers.

maria: I'll update the SDK snippet. Proposed replacement (JS):```js
const res = await client.generate({
  model: 'orca-lite-13b-q4',
  input: 'Summarize...',
  response_mode: 'stream' // replaced old `stream: true`
});
for await (const chunk of res) console.log(chunk.text);
```

sophia: CI is failing on a docs link path (anchors changed). I pushed a tiny fix on top of the branch — please review.

ci-bot: build/docs: #4872 — linkcheck failed on /model-catalog/orca-lite-13b-q4.html#quantized-notes (404)

alex: Thanks @sophia for the link fix. Should we add a short "migration guide" subsection at the bottom of each model card for SDK/CLI changes? That would centralize notes.

bryan: +1. Suggested headings: "Breaking changes", "SDK snippet migration", "Effective limits for quantized builds". Keep each entry 2-3 bullets max.

maria: I'll draft the SDK migration bullets and push as a follow-up commit. Want to include a small code diff too.

sophia: I'll add the hardware table and update the bench section with p50/p95/p99 and commit details (commit sha + date).

alex: Great. Tagging reviewers: @maria @bryan @sophia — can we aim to merge by EOD tomorrow? I need this in the weekly release notes. :thumbsup:

bryan: I can review after lunch.

maria: Will send the snippet diff in 30m.

sophia: Done a second pass on wording for "effective context" — ping me for wording tweaks.

ci-bot: build/docs: #4872 — linkcheck passed (after fixes)

alex: Merged. Thanks team — I'll follow up to add the migration guide template so other model cards can copy it.

maria: Awesome, will update the SDK changelog entry too.

bryan: Nice!
